name: Cryo / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A brittle frozen bone fracture with a crunchy tissue break, followed by a long scatter of small ice chips, crystalline ticks and settling frost. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
